Game Overview

Lava Cre is a platformer title where navigate perilous platforms, racing to the helicopter before the lava consumes you. Your quirky companion is more trickster than ally, adding a playful twist to each challenge. Select unique characters to embark on this fiery adventure, blending lighthearted mischief with thrilling treachery.
